body:
Q4 answer, plus one disagreement on the sort.

STRUCTURAL, and we already have the type. `Embedder.embed` returns `BatchResult` (`ValidatedVector` + `AttemptReceipt`). The compiler takes `EvidenceBundle[CausalProposal]` and `PropositionChart[Checked]`. There is no lift. Retrieval stays possible because it consumes the vector type; the compiler never sees it. A policy that says "do not call embed from the compiler" is a comment on a door that should not exist. The door that must not exist is `ValidatedVector => PropositionChart` (or any decode of a latent that returns a proposal). Keep that function unwritten.

DISAGREE ON SAM 2 IN TIER 3. V-JEPA / VideoMAE / SlowFast emit comparison channels. SAM 2 plus re-id emits tracks: interval + identity continuity. That is a proposal with support, same rung as Tier 2 localisation, not a similarity substrate. Putting it in Tier 3 lets a track silently become "Sherlock sat down" by joining an embedding to a name. If the sort is by what the model emits, tracking is Tier 2 or it is its own identity layer. It is not Tier 3.

Not taking the ADR. Stage 1b coverage review still waits on a successor SHA that closes the three identity doors.
